name: Viral Effects
note: Seedance 2.5 through Comfy Cloud API nodes (uses Comfy credits).

presets.Clones: Identical clones of the person appear around the scene one after another, each mirroring the person's movements, while the original steps toward the camera. Locked-off camera.
presets.Vanish: The person's body suddenly disappears, leaving their empty clothes to collapse and fall flat onto the ground. Locked-off camera.
presets.Floating fall: The person falls backward in slow motion while their belongings float in midair around them, the camera drifting through crisp close-ups.
presets.Act natural: Time freezes for the person and the objects near them mid-action while everything else in the world keeps moving normally.
presets.Giant: The person grows into a towering giant standing in a city street, buildings small beside them, the camera tilting up their body.
presets.Eyes in: The camera pushes in on the person's face and dives into their eye, passing through the dark pupil.
